Mental Health Treatment in North Jersey
Reviewed On: October 31, 2025
Areas We Serve

When you struggle with mental health, it can impact every area of your life, from how you think to how you feel and even how you relate to others. Some days, it’s difficult to concentrate or muster the energy to do activities you once enjoyed. Other days, it’s a struggle to simply get through the next hour. Whether you struggle with anxiety, depression, trauma, or a variety of issues that can be difficult to disentangle, one thing is clear: finding the right support can make all the difference in the world. You are not alone. 1 in 5 adults in New Jersey suffer from a mental health condition, and our goal is to provide relief to all of those in need.

At Garden Springs Wellness, we know that accessing support shouldn’t add additional stress to your life. You shouldn’t have to travel hours or jump through bureaucratic hoops to get the help you deserve. That’s why our mission is to make mental health treatment as local, as real, and as accessible as possible.

blocks.text: We’re proud to offer evidence-based, compassionate treatment to clients and families throughout Northern New Jersey. Our location in Englewood, NJ, serves people in Bergen County and surrounding areas who are ready to take the next step in their healing journey. Whether you are just starting on your path to wellness or have been working on healing from trauma and other mental health issues, we are here to walk beside you with the tools, structure, and support you need to begin to regain balance in your life.
At Garden Springs Wellness, you will experience a local, personalized approach that is grounded in empathy and a deep understanding of mental health care.
Our Facility in Englewood, NJ

At Garden Springs Wellness, our Englewood facility was designed with just one purpose in mind: to make you feel calm and at ease, so that you can believe in the possibility of recovery. We wanted to create a space that didn’t feel or look like a hospital but instead one that would welcome you in and show you that healing is possible here.

blocks.text: Englewood is in the heart of Bergen County, and so is easily accessible from the many neighboring towns across North Jersey. We chose to be located in Englewood because we believe in providing care to our community in a way that is convenient, comfortable and, most importantly, local.

As soon as you walk into our Englewood center, you will feel different. There is a peacefulness that settles over the space. Staff members know your name. We listen before we talk and we take the time to get to know the story of who you are, what you’ve been through, and not just the list of symptoms you’re experiencing, so that we can help you move forward in a way that works with your life.

At our mental health facility in North Jersey, we bring together the rigor and attention to detail of the highest level of clinical care with a focus on the human connection. From every therapist, psychiatrist, and support specialist on our team, the mission is the same: to help you heal and stay well. We work closely with you and with each other to ensure your treatment plan is tailored to your goals, schedule, and needs.
When you come to Garden Springs Wellness, you become part of a community that believes in your ability to heal.
Comprehensive Mental Health and Behavioral Health Services

runs.t: Comprehensive Mental Health and Behavioral Health Services

blocks.text: PHP is a great fit for those needing organized, intensive care during the day, but who wish to return home at night. You will be spending several hours a day engaged in treatment which may include one-on-one counseling, group therapy and skill-building activities. Psychiatric care is also available to help with symptom management while allowing room for emotional processing and healing. You will work to achieve stabilization, practice new tools and techniques and prepare for your next steps in recovery.

blocks.text: The IOP offers the same level of care as our PHP, with added flexibility. IOP is a good option for individuals who are maintaining their recovery while working or going to school and have families. It’s an ideal mix of treatment and independence. You will receive individual and group therapy for a few days each week to focus on stress reduction, relapse prevention, communication, and emotional regulation. It’s a transitional step back to everyday life after more intensive treatment.

blocks.text: Outpatient therapy provides a space for ongoing support once you’ve gained stability. You’ll meet one-on-one with a therapist who understands your challenges and helps you keep growing. Sessions may focus on relationships, managing anxiety or depression, processing trauma, or adjusting to life after treatment. It’s not just about managing symptoms — it’s about learning to feel at peace in your own skin again.

blocks.text: Medication can sometimes help restore equilibrium to your mind and body. Our psychiatric team partners with you to discover options and track their effectiveness over time. We are transparent about each step, answer your questions candidly, and adjust your plan as your needs evolve. Our ultimate aim is always to help you regain a sense of yourself — not lose it.

At its core, aftercare is about continuation, not completion. You’ve already done the hard work of beginning your healing — now, this is how you protect it. It’s the step that transforms progress into permanence, helping you hold on to everything you’ve gained and continue to grow stronger, day by day.
Services Available in Our North Jersey Mental Health Programs
At Garden Springs Wellness Center, our outpatient mental health treatment program in North Jersey employs a diverse range of evidence-based therapies, ensuring comprehensive care for our clients:

CBT is a cornerstone of our treatment programs, focusing on identifying and altering negative thought patterns and behaviors. This therapy helps individuals develop healthier ways of thinking, leading to improved emotional regulation and behavior.

DBT is particularly effective for individuals dealing with severe emotional disturbances. It combines cognitive behavioral techniques with mindfulness practices, enhancing emotional and cognitive regulation and teaching skills to manage distress and improve interpersonal relationships.

Our licensed therapists offer one-on-one sessions to delve deep into personal challenges, providing a safe space to explore and address underlying issues. Personalized therapy aims to develop coping strategies and facilitate personal growth and healing.

Our team of experienced psychiatrists provides medical assessments and manages medications as part of a holistic approach to mental health care. Medication management can be an essential component of treatment for many individuals, ensuring the best possible outcomes.

Recognizing the importance of treating the whole person, we offer various holistic therapies, including mindfulness practices, yoga, and art therapy. These therapies support overall well-being, reduce stress, and enhance the therapeutic process.

Our entire team is proud to call Bergen County home and has developed relationships with neighboring towns throughout Northern New Jersey. We are honored to be an integral part of your community.

We understand that every community is unique, with its own cultures, challenges, and strengths — and that’s exactly why it matters where you get care. No matter if you’re a student facing academic pressure, a parent trying to balance the needs of family and mental health, or just looking for a change of scenery, Garden Springs Wellness is here to help.

Our facility serves as more than a treatment center; it’s a community. We work to foster relationships with the communities we’re a part of — connecting our clients to local support networks, aftercare resources, and ongoing therapy after their treatment journey has ended.
Garden Springs Wellness doesn’t just want to help individuals heal; we want to help communities grow stronger, one person at a time.
Why Local Mental Health Care in North Jersey Matters
Traveling Long Distances for Care

Traveling long distances for care may add unnecessary stress to an already difficult time. Remaining close to home makes care more accessible — and more manageable to commit to. But there is a deeper aspect to local treatment, as well. Your care is stronger when it is deeply rooted in the community in which you live.
Better Recovery Outcomes

Greater proximity means greater consistency, and that consistency leads to better outcomes in treatment. You don’t need to upend your life just to access care. There are far fewer logistical barriers to your recovery. With local care, the focus is on you and your healing.
Family Involvement

You don’t heal in a bubble. When care is nearby, your support network can be nearby, too. That means loved ones can be involved in ways that are comfortable and meaningful, whether that means therapy sessions or support group meetings, educating themselves to better support you or simply being within reach when you need them. Connection is a powerful force during recovery.
Seamless Transitions Between Programs

Recovery is rarely a linear process. There are times when you might need more support, and times when you need to build more independence. With local care, you can more easily transition between programs, like PHP and IOP, individual therapy or aftercare without losing time or transferring to a new team.
Community-Based Recovery

In local care, you are not just healing — you are learning to live better within your natural environment, the environment you may have been using before treatment. That is the work of healing. Within that environment, you begin to put coping skills to the test, identify local resources, and build a better life right where you are.
Begin Your Path to Wellness Today With Garden Springs Mental Health Treatment in North Jersey

Healing doesn’t happen overnight, but it starts the moment you reach out. At Garden Springs Wellness, we’re here to make that first step easier — by offering the guidance, compassion, and clinical support you need to move forward.

Our programs are open to individuals across Northern New Jersey who are ready to take charge of their mental health and build a life that feels balanced again. Whether you’re searching for mental health programs near me or need a trusted mental health facility in North Jersey, we’re ready to help.

You don’t have to keep pushing through on your own. Real help is closer than you think — and it starts here, with a team that believes in you. Contact Garden Springs Wellness today to learn more about our programs and discover how we can help you heal, grow, and thrive right here in your community.
